thesis: MANH is a high-quality grower, but the entry is poor on timing and price. Valuation is rich (forward P/E 40.9, P/S 12.7) and the stock is extended after a gap-up (RSI14 67.7, 6.2% above SMA20) while the tape is risk-off with technology the lagging sector (XLK, SMH sharply down, QQQ below its 50- and 200-day averages). Reward/risk from the entry zone is only about 1.21, thin compensation for a high-beta software name in a regime where multiples compress first. Earnings growth (+4.6% YoY) lags revenue growth (+11.0%), so the premium multiple is not backed by earnings acceleration. News was unavailable this run, so the reaction to the 10-Q and the earnings report is unknown; this is missing data, not a binary event, and it argues for smaller size rather than a veto.
